What Is Eco-Anxiety?

Climate change and environmental destruction are not just physical threats — they deeply affect the mental and emotional well-being of young people around the world.

Eco-anxiety is a growing concern among young people. Climate change, rising temperatures, pollution, floods, and deforestation are becoming serious environmental challenges. Constantly worrying about these problems and the future of our planet creates feelings of fear, stress, and helplessness.

The problem is not just environmental damage — it's also how that damage affects the mental and emotional well-being of young people. This psychological burden has a name: Eco-Anxiety.

Causes of Eco-Anxiety

Multiple factors contribute to eco-anxiety among young people. Hover or tap each card to learn more about each cause.

🌪️
Extreme Weather Events
Hover to learn more
🌪️ Extreme Weather
Cyclones, droughts, wildfires and floods are increasing. Witnessing or hearing about these disasters repeatedly amplifies fear and distress among youth.
🦋
Biodiversity Loss
Hover to learn more
🦋 Biodiversity Loss
The rapid disappearance of species and ecosystems creates deep grief and worry about a future where nature no longer exists as we know it.
🌲
Deforestation
Hover to learn more
🌲 Deforestation
Large-scale deforestation for agriculture and industry destroys natural habitats, reduces air quality, and fuels climate anxiety in young people.
💨
Increasing Pollution
Hover to learn more
💨 Pollution
Rising air, water and plastic pollution leaves young people feeling that the damage is irreversible — intensifying feelings of despair and helplessness.
📱
Social Media Overload
Hover to learn more
📱 Media Exposure
Constant exposure to alarming climate news and disaster footage on social media amplifies anxiety, especially for youth who spend hours online each day.
😟
Uncertain Future
Hover to learn more
😟 Uncertain Future
Young people feel frustrated when they see insufficient action from governments and industries. This perceived powerlessness makes problems feel too large to solve.
⏱ 1:05 – 1:45 · Section 3

Turning Concern Into Action

Eco-anxiety doesn't have to be paralyzing. Here are three powerful ways to transform worry into positive, purposeful action. Check off habits you're ready to adopt!

🏠
Level 1: Sustainable Habits
  • Save water & electricity daily
  • Reduce single-use plastic
  • Choose public transport
  • Compost food waste
  • Support local & sustainable products
🏫
Level 2: Educational Initiatives
  • Join environmental education programs
  • Participate in campus recycling
  • Join tree-planting activities
  • Attend climate awareness workshops
  • Discuss eco-issues in classrooms
🤝
Level 3: Community Action
  • Form an environmental club
  • Organise community clean-up drives
  • Spread awareness on social media
  • Petition local authorities for change
  • Mentor younger students
Working together gives young people a sense of purpose and hope — the most powerful antidote to eco-anxiety.

Implementation Plan

A clear, structured three-step roadmap to transform eco-anxiety into organized community action — involving students, teachers, and local communities.

1
📢
Step One
Awareness
▼

Organise workshops and campaigns in colleges to educate students about climate change and eco-anxiety. Create awareness about environmental challenges and their mental health impact. Use posters, seminars, and guest lectures to build knowledge.

📚 Workshops 🎤 Seminars 🪧 Campaigns 🎓 Guest Lectures
2
🌳
Step Two
Participation
▼

Create student-led environmental clubs and organise monthly clean-up drives, recycling campaigns, and tree-planting activities. Encourage active involvement from all students and faculty. Make participation a regular, celebrated campus culture.

♻️ Recycling Drives 🌱 Tree Planting 🧹 Clean-up Drives 🏆 Eco Clubs
3
📊
Step Three
Evaluation
▼

Track participation numbers, waste collected, and trees maintained to measure our progress. Regular evaluation helps identify what works and where improvements are needed. Share results openly to motivate continued action across the community.

📈 Progress Tracking 📋 Reports 🎯 Goal Setting 🤝 Community Review
